nodes.statement:
For all $u \in \tilde{W}_h$ it holds
\begin{align}

\int_0^T \!\! \Vert u(\cdot,t) \Vert_{\partial \Omega^{h}(t)}^2 ~ \mathrm{d}t
& \lesssim
  \Vert u \Vert_{\partial_s Q^h}^2 
\lesssim \| \nabla u \|_{Q^h}^2 \!+\! \Delta t^2 \| \partial_t^\Theta u\|_{Q^h}^2  \\ 
	& \leq C_{stra_ineq_stronger} \min \{|\!|\!| u |\!|\!|^2, |\!|\!| u |\!|\!|_{\ast}^2\}, \!\!  \\
  \| u \|_{Q^h} & \lesssim \min \{|\!|\!| u |\!|\!|, |\!|\!| u |\!|\!|_{\ast}\}. 
\end{align}
